def title_of(html: str) -> str:
    """Text between the first `<title>` and the next `</title>` in html, or "" if there is no such pair."""
    ex title_of("<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") == "Hello"
    ex title_of("<html></html>") == ""
    ex title_of("<title>Unclosed") == ""
    ex title_of("<title></title>") == ""
    before, sep, rest = html.partition("<title>")
    if sep == "":
        return ""
    text, sep2, after = rest.partition("</title>")
    if sep2 == "":
        return ""
    return text
